xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2355: Overdeck Anywhere P2: mobile PWA (Needs-You feed, conversation view, pipeline board, Web Push)

plan.title: Overdeck Anywhere P2: mobile PWA (Needs-You feed, conversation view, pipeline board, Web Push)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Epic FR-16/W-PHONE2: the phone must install one machine's dashboard as a PWA over Tailscale Serve HTTPS and answer an AskUserQuestion in three taps or fewer. Today there is no manifest, service worker or phone layout; no URL opens a specific question; an installed iPhone app cannot reuse a Safari pairing cookie and cannot type a 64-character pairing code; and with require_token_mint off a phone at the Serve address would get the root session.
narratives.Proposal: Add a hand-written service worker (push and notificationclick only, never caching) and a manifest with start_url /m; a lazy-loaded standalone phone shell at /m with Needs you (question cards that answer through a transport module extracted from usePendingInputDialogs) and Conversations (reusing ConversationPanel unchanged); in-app pairing by camera scan (jsqr) or paste that hands the code to the existing #pair= bootstrap; a Settings -> Anywhere 'Set up a phone' dialog that refuses to show a pairing code until require_token_mint is on and links ${origin}/m#pair=; a Playwright phone-viewport spec proving the two in-app taps and 44px targets; CI allowlist wiring; and configuration/phone.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No Web Push sending, VAPID keys, subscription routes or 'Turn on notifications' control (PAN-2354 owns them)
- No pipeline board tab (PAN-4661)
- No Tailscale install, sign-in, Serve setup or detection code (PAN-1254)
- No automatic require_token_mint enabling and no server auth changes (PAN-4645 W-SEC4)
- No fleet aggregation of conversations or needs-you rows (PAN-4650, PAN-4651)
- No new HTTP routes and no server-side code changes
- No edits to ConversationPanel.tsx and no file-size allowlist raises
- No service-worker caching, precache, offline page, respondWith or vite-plugin-pwa/Workbox
- No second service worker file or second registration
- No terminals on the phone; no answering permission prompts, plan approvals or pane choices from the phone feed; no true multiSelect answers
- No desktop-to-/m redirect or 'switch to mobile' banner; no change to desktop layouts
- No per-machine manifest names
- No CSRF unification of the answer routes (they keep plain JSON headers)
- No edits to configuration/remote-access.mdx or configuration/tailscale.mdx
- No interactive mockup gate

autoDecisions.summary: Plan against the rescoped issue body (W-PHONE2, FR-16) and rebaseline .pan/drafts/pan-2355.md in place
autoDecisions.rationale: The July draft depended on the closed PAN-2352 and owned Web Push, which the rev-5 epic moved to PAN-2354; the role rule says correct a drifted PRD in place.

autoDecisions.summary: Skip the interactive mockup gate; require Playwright screenshots of each phone screen in the PR instead
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's mockup rule targets redesigns of established surfaces; /m is new, and the epic assigned a mockup issue (PAN-4646) only to W-CONV5.

autoDecisions.summary: Move the pipeline board tab to the follow-up PAN-4661
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-16 and the W-PHONE2 done check do not need it, and dropping it keeps the plan at or under the 25-file projected-surface limit without a size justification.

autoDecisions.summary: This issue owns public/sw.js including push and notificationclick handlers; PAN-2354 owns VAPID, subscriptions, sending and the notifications control; payload {title, body, url, tag?}
autoDecisions.rationale: Both issues need the worker; one owner prevents two workers. The PAN-2354 planner was told via pan tell, with an extend-never-duplicate rule for whichever lands second.

autoDecisions.summary: Deep links are query parameters on /m (?subject, ?tab, ?conversation), not path segments
autoDecisions.rationale: The static server 404s a missing path whose last segment has an extension, so ids with dots in a path would break.

autoDecisions.summary: Hand-written service worker with no fetch handler instead of vite-plugin-pwa
autoDecisions.rationale: index.html is deliberately no-cache and its boot watchdog polls /; caching would break both and risk stale state; no dependency is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: In-app pairing by camera scan with the jsqr@1.4.0 decoder plus paste fallback
autoDecisions.rationale: An installed iPhone app has storage separate from Safari and the 64-hex pairing code cannot be typed; iOS Safari lacks BarcodeDetector.

autoDecisions.summary: The setup dialog gates the pairing code on require_token_mint and links to the existing setting instead of writing settings
autoDecisions.rationale: With the flag off a phone at the Serve address gets root; PAN-4645 owns auto-enabling, so this issue only refuses to proceed and never adds a second settings writer.

autoDecisions.summary: Add one user doc page configuration/phone.mdx although the issue body says Docs: None
autoDecisions.rationale: The iPhone install-then-pair order and the require_token_mint step are documented nowhere else, and the PRD authoring rule plus the finalize gate require a docs item; remote-access.mdx and tailscale.mdx are left to PAN-1254/PAN-4645.
It is the default Broadsheet dark background (index.css:481-483).

items.title: Extract the AUQ answer transports into lib/pendingInputAnswer.ts

narrative.Action: PRD W-1 (D-12). Create FE/src/lib/pendingInputAnswer.ts exporting parseCodexOptionNumber, buildPendingAnswerRequest(target: PendingAnswerTarget) and postPendingAnswer(request, failureLabel) exactly as specified in PRD FR-8. Move the endpoint/body choice out of usePendingInputDialogs.ts (askUserQuestionAnswerMutation and codexApprovalMutation mutationFns, lines ~359-470, and the inline /^\s*(\d+)/ parse in handleSubmitAskUserQuestion) into the module; keep onMutate/onSuccess/onError/toasts unchanged and keep the plain {'Content-Type':'application/json'} headers. The prose fallback text must stay byte-identical. Add harness?: string | null to ConversationPendingInputRow and Decision in FE/src/lib/useDecisions.ts and set harness: c.harness ?? null in the useDecisions() conversation loop. Behavior-preserving refactor: usePendingInputDialogs.ts must only shrink.

Given a conv target with harness 'ohmypi' or 'pi', when buildPendingAnswerRequest runs, then it returns url /api/conversations/<id>/pi-ask-answer with body {toolUseId, answers}

Add public/sw.js with push and notificationclick handlers and no caching

narrative.Action: PRD W-3 (D-1, D-2, D-5). First run `git ls-files src/dashboard/frontend/public/sw.js`; if PAN-2354 already added it, extend that file instead of creating one (never a second worker). Write plain ES2020 with no imports: install -> self.skipWaiting(); activate -> event.waitUntil(self.clients.claim()); expose self.overdeckNotificationFromPush(text) returning {title, options:{body, tag, data:{url}}} per the D-2 contract (invalid JSON -> title 'Overdeck', body 'Something needs you', url '/m'; missing or cross-origin url -> '/m'); push -> event.waitUntil(self.registration.showNotification(title, options)); notificationclick -> close, clients.matchAll({type:'window', includeUncontrolled:true}), focus+navigate the first same-origin client or clients.openWindow(url). No fetch listener unless the D-5 installability checkpoint fails, and then only a listener that never calls respondWith. Header comment states D-1, D-2 and D-5 including the extend-never-duplicate rule.

items.title: Given the built dashboard, when GET /sw.js is requested, then it returns 200 with a text/javascript content-type

Given push text {"title":"T","body":"B","url":"/m?subject=c1"}, when overdeckNotificationFromPush runs, then it returns title 'T' with options.data.url ending in '/m?subject=c1'; given url 'https://evil.example/x' or invalid JSON, then data.url ends in '/m'
Given sw.js, when grep counts 'caches.' and 'respondWith', then the count is 0 (no caching, no request interception)
